from Garbhakaulāgama. Bomb. Uni. 1406. Taylor II. 414. 443. Trav. Uni. 5834G. C.. the following entries.

Āścaryaparvan
a name of the Harivaṁśa.

Āścaryamañjarī
a gadya kāvya by Kulaśekhara; ref. to by a. in the prologue to his drama Tapatīsamvaraṇa, TSS. 11, p. 5. Praised by Rājaśekhara, see Sūktimuktāvali, GOS., p. 46. Q. also by Rāyamukuṭa an. other commentators on Amarakośa, (e. g. Ṭīkāsarvasva, TSS. III. 83, 177; Kaumudī, Adyar D. VI. 978). See also Poona Ori., VII. i-ii, p. 68, q. in Śivakośa; AIOC. IX. Trivandrum Proc. p. 16.
